description: Information system does not implement required cryptographic protection using cryptographic modules.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for use of non-FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules, weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms, missing encryption for sensitive data, inadequate cryptographic strength, absence of cryptographic protection for data in transit and at rest, and lack of validation certificates for cryptographic implementations.
